author: quality-assurance
text: Final independent BL-0010 review found no high or medium issues in the reviewed code and evidence. Recorded real-host A/B/C checks cover folder handoff and use, overlapping same-role invocations, follow-up and a second Activity; independent archived hash readback matched all 10 recorded files. Fixture fault injection and controlled pre-dispatch abort are not real failed or uncertain launches. Allocation does not launch agents, and closure/writer safety relies on host coordination rather than OS isolation. Full suites were reviewed from recorded results, not rerun by this invocation.

provenance.source: quality-assurance independent review of BL-0010 implementation and recorded evidence
